# Restore the 21 buildScripts specs that pass verbatim after the ai/ path sweep

Related: #17922 · Refs #17791 · Refs #17920

## Context

#17922 censused the 30 specs `c623b2f63c` deleted from `test/playwright/unit/ai/buildScripts/**` and found **27** whose implementation never left this repository — the census first read 22 and was five short; #17922 now carries the corrected figure and the cause. Its ACs cover all 27 plus a `check-spec-retirement` replay arm and a collected-count assertion.

Restoring all 27 is not one PR. Six of the 27 specs with a surviving subject do **not** pass against `dev` today, and each failure is a finding that needs its own repair — not a trim. This ticket is the split #17922 asks for: it takes the subset that restores **verbatim and green**, so 21 guards regain coverage now instead of waiting on six unrelated repairs.

Live latest-open sweep: checked the latest 20 open issues at 2026-08-31T08:23:50Z; no equivalent found. A2A claim sweep over the last 12 messages (all read-states) at the same time: the only claim on this scope is my own `[lane-claim][Engine #17922]` at 08:12:48Z.

## The Problem

Every green `unit` run since 2026-08-27 has certified 256 spec files while reading as the same signal that used to certify far more. For these 21 subjects the guard is still executed — by `.github/workflows/*-lint.yml`, `.husky/pre-commit`, `.husky/pre-push` and `package.json` — while nothing at all verifies that the guard still detects what it was written to detect.

The specs were selected for deletion by their `test/playwright/unit/ai/` **path prefix**, never by their subject. `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/` — the sibling with no `ai/` prefix — survived the same sweep untouched and is populated with 17 specs today. That is the destination, and it is why restoring to the old paths would re-arm the identical deletion at the next boundary change.

## The Architectural Reality

- Destination `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/**`; `playwright.config.unit.mjs:33` sets `testDir` to `test/playwright/unit`, so any depth beneath it is collected.
- Relocation is one level shallower, so both depth-encoding forms shift by exactly one: `from '…'` specifiers and `path.resolve(__dirname, '…')` chains.
- Fixture strings that *contain* an import statement (`check-examples-body-only.spec.mjs`) are relative to a temp fixture directory, not to the spec. They must not be rewritten — doing so silently changes what the fixture asserts.
- `DataSyncPipeline.spec.mjs` is the one spec whose subject survived but whose import did not: `CREDENTIAL_FAMILIES` from `ai/services/fleet/redactCredentials.mjs`.

## The Fix

Restore the 21 specs that pass verbatim into `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/**`, preserving the sub-structure so the layout keeps mirroring `buildScripts/`. Re-express the 28 depth-encoding specifiers. Change no implementation.

> **Correction (2026-08-31):** this step first said **34**. An exact old-blob/new-blob pairing over the 21 added files — 21/21 paired, 0 ambiguous, 0 unpaired — measures **28** changed depth specifiers, **26** whitespace-only lines, **0** other content changes and **0** line-count drift. Raised by @neo-gpt-emmy on PR #17925 and reproduced independently before folding; two earlier instruments gave 40 and 0 for instrument reasons, both recorded in [issuecomment-5476448295](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/17925#issuecomment-5476448295). The commit body carried the superseded 34 until 2026-08-31 12:58Z; `1e71d92` was amended to `d3be105` — message only, tree byte-identical (`git diff 1e71d92 d3be105` is empty) — so no operative artifact says 34 any more.

The six that do not pass stay out, each with its cause recorded rather than trimmed into silence:

| deferred spec | why it is not restored here |
|---|---|
| `DataSyncPipeline.spec.mjs` | reds on the missing `syncGithubWorkflow.mjs --emit-only` stage — the #17920 defect, witnessed. Belongs to that PR. |
| `util/check-theme-surfaces.spec.mjs` | fixtures drive `--fm-*` tokens; `collectShellSeamFailures` and the Fleet Manager surface left in `07704934c3` (#17805). Needs fixtures re-pointed at the Workstation surface. |
| `docs/RebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.spec.mjs` | asserts against `ai/services/github-workflow/SyncService.mjs`, which legitimately left. |
| `release/PublishReleaseNoteOrphan.spec.mjs` | asserts against `ai/scripts/lifecycle/postReleaseSync.mjs`, which legitimately left. |
| `util/WorkflowConcurrency.spec.mjs` | asserts `ai/services/memory-core/MemoryService.mjs` trips the parity lane; that path is no longer here. |
| `util/WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` | expects `run_integration` / `run_components` admissions the classifier no longer makes post-split. |

Five of the six share one shape: the spec encodes an expectation **about** an `ai/**` artifact that correctly departed. That is a rewrite against current topology, not a restoration, which is why it is not bundled here.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The 21 specs exist under `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/**` and `npm run test-unit` exits 0.
- [ ] Each of the 21 is shown **red** against a seeded mutation of its own subject — the subject's export shape preserved, its behavior removed. A spec that stays green against a gutted subject never exercised it.
- [ ] The collected spec-file count under `test/playwright/unit` is measured before and after and rises by exactly 21, by count and not by a green run.
- [ ] No implementation file under `buildScripts/**` is modified.
- [ ] No restored spec is trimmed to make the suite green; every spec that could not be restored names its drift in the PR body and is filed.

## Out of Scope

- **The six deferred specs.** Each needs a repair against current topology; #17922 keeps them.
- **#17922's AC-4** — the `check-spec-retirement` replay over `c623b2f63c`'s 30 deletions. It is a guard change, not a restoration, and stays with the parent.
- **The other 774 deletions.** #17922 censused `unit/ai/buildScripts/**` only and makes no claim about the rest.
- **Changing what any of the 21 implementations does.** Restoration is not the moment to fix the subject.
- **Making `spec-retirement-lint.yml` blocking** — #17171 owns required-context binding for the whole `*-lint.yml` family.

## Avoided Traps

- **Restoring to the old `ai/` paths.** The prefix is what made the bulk sweep classify them as Brain substrate; putting them back re-arms the deletion.
- **Trimming a failing spec to make the suite green.** A spec failing against its subject is a finding about the subject. Deleting the assertion reproduces #17922 in miniature — which is why six specs are deferred with a named cause instead of edited into passing.
- **Rewriting fixture strings that look like imports.** They are relative to a temp directory; a depth rewrite changes the assertion silently and the spec still passes.
- **Treating a green `unit` run as evidence of restored coverage.** The whole finding is that green survived a mass deletion. The count delta and the per-spec mutation are the honest instruments.
- **Bundling the six repairs in to "finish" #17922.** That trades a verifiable 21 for a PR nobody can review, and delays coverage that is ready now.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — no ADR authority is touched. Test files move within this repository; no boundary is crossed.
